data.why: The brief's outcomes are in 2 different capabilities, so the route is several epics.

high_risk.basis: Applied to the files each shipped rule's slice changed when it was merged, as this computer has them. The rule is the security scan's (sign-in or permissions, billing, a database schema or migration, an existing contract).

areas.area: The finding is in code for billing or payments, which is High risk.
The finding is in code for sign-in or permissions, which is High risk.

data.rule: One outcome and at most three shipped rules is one slice; otherwise outcomes inside one capability is an epic, and outcomes in different capabilities is several epics. High-risk areas and concerns are counted, never part of the rule.
data.note: A script counted and named the route; nothing was created. A map of slices is proposed next.
